edinburgh_home_e_gran.text: Archie, stop looking glaikit. That means blank and a bit gormless, dear. Archie has a very good glaikit look.
Every day but Sunday, the One O'Clock Gun fires from the Castle. We have never once had to set a clock by anything else.

edinburgh_home_e_archie.text: Gran says the gun is an Edinburgh tradition. I say it is an alarm clock for the whole city.
